courses.overview: 跨單元連結與比較練習

related.title: 船舶螺槳空蝕評估
related.why: 比較兩個系統的負載、能源或資料介面，列出不可直接沿用的邊界條件。
related.whyEn: Compare load, energy or data interfaces and identify boundary conditions that cannot be transferred.
related.difference: 船體尺度、載荷條件、海況及驗證目的必須分別設定。
related.differenceEn: Vessel scale, load conditions, sea state and verification purpose require separate definitions.
practice: 各選一個教學算例，記下輸入、輸出與單位。
對照兩課的系統邊界，說明哪些假設不能沿用。
改變一個輸入，提出量測與失效判據來核對結果。
practiceEn: Choose one worked example from each course and record inputs, outputs and units.
Compare system boundaries and identify assumptions that cannot transfer.
Change one input and propose measurements and failure criteria to check the result.

courses.summary: 本專題以往返走時與厚度基準建立起點，接到熱影響區背景辨識的系統介面，最後用可追溯掃描與未覆蓋區整合證據。這是原創教學進程，不是假稱現場工程紀錄。
courses.summaryEn: Begin with Round-trip time and thickness reference, connect through Heat-affected-zone context, then integrate evidence using Traceable scans and uncovered regions. This is an original teaching progression, not a claimed field record.

history.title: 船體焊道無損檢測
history.text: 本專題以往返走時與厚度基準建立起點，接到熱影響區背景辨識的系統介面，最後用可追溯掃描與未覆蓋區整合證據。這是原創教學進程，不是假稱現場工程紀錄。
history.textEn: Begin with Round-trip time and thickness reference, connect through Heat-affected-zone context, then integrate evidence using Traceable scans and uncovered regions. This is an original teaching progression, not a claimed field record.

courses.connection: 以合成A掃描、試塊和缺陷圖建立NDT判讀證據，避免把單一回波當成缺陷尺寸。 在焊道無損檢測資料實驗室依十個單元完成機制觀察、定量比較、量測驗證與故障診斷；各算例為獨立教學假設，完整保留資料來源與模型限制。
courses.connectionEn: Build NDT interpretation from synthetic A-scans, reference blocks and indication maps rather than one echo amplitude. Complete ten units of mechanisms, quantitative comparisons, measurement verification and diagnosis in the Weld NDE data laboratory. Examples are independent teaching assumptions with sources and model limitations retained.
